thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: error-rate spike detected for text-gen-prod region-us-west. primary oncall @sam, severity: SEV2. automatic mitigation policy applied (throttling)

sam: Acknowledged. Joining bridge now. Can someone open a bridge and grab spans/logs?

katie: On it — created bridge: https://meet.company/bridge/1765001234. Inviting eng-sre and product.

sam: On bridge. Early observation: 5xxs mostly around model worker pool OOMs. Rolling a small scale-down of batch size to reduce mem pressure as immediate mitigation. Will monitor.

miguel: I see the same in logs, dumping a tail here:
```
worker-12 ERROR oom when allocating tensor of size 1.2GB
worker-15 ERROR allocator ran out of memory
requests: spike from 120rps -> 480rps over 2m
```

elaine: Noted. Any config changes deployed recently?

sam: There's a rolling config change from last night that increased max-concurrency on text-gen-prod (PR #4467) to improve throughput. Reverting that as testing mitigation now.

jordan: Support: we have 3 customers reporting 5xx in APAC (tickets #4521, #4527, #4530). They're seeing timeouts and partial responses. Customer impact: degraded for <10% of calls but for high-traffic customers it's visible.

dave: Revert completed, scaled down concurrency, cleared a few stuck KV caches. Metrics trending back toward baseline. Error-rate down from 4.2% -> 0.6% in 8m.

sam: Good. Keeping bridge open for 30m to ensure stability. Please collect relevant spans, traces, and commit hashes for the change.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: incident-1765001234. Severity SEV2. Notifying postmortem queue.

katie: OK — post-incident actions: schedule postmortem, gather timeline + evidence, list customer impact, assign remediation owners. I can run the scheduling and notes. Tentative PM: @katie. Need owners for timeline, mitigation, infra fixes, customer comms, legal review.

sam: I'll own initial timeline and mitigation writeup (root cause hypothesis: config increase + insufficient VM headroom for bursty traffic).

miguel: I'll collect logs, traces, relevant CPU/mem graphs, and the PR diff for #4467.

elaine: I'll draft the mitigation steps and propose follow-up infra changes (auto-rollback guard, memory headroom alerts).

jordan: I'll draft the customer impact summary and proposed comms. Support will compile customer ticket list.

dave: I'll own the remediation (SRE) action items: autoscaling policy tweak, add a gating test for concurrency change, and a per-model mem safety limit.

mary: Legal here — I'll review any high-risk customer comms and flag any compliance concerns. Please loop me in at least 48h before outbound comms.

support: We'll attach the customer tickets and any transcripts to the postmortem doc. ETA end of day.

katie: Timeline proposal: draft RCA in 72h (by 1765250000), peer review within 48h after draft, final sign-off and public comms (if needed) in 7 days. If anyone can't meet those windows, call it out now.

sam: 72h works for me. Setting a reminder.

miguel: Fine for evidence collection; might need an extra day for log retention pulls, but will try to hit 72h.

elaine: I'll put proposed infra tasks into the backlog and tag with incident-1765001234.

sam: Draft location: Google Drive — https://drive.company/r/incident-1765001234-rca (uploaded initial notes and timeline). Please add your sections as you have them.

katie: Great. Action items so far (quick list):
- sam: RCA draft (72h)
- miguel: logs/traces + PR diff (48-72h)
- elaine: mitigation writeup + infra task creation (48h)
- dave: remediation plan + gating tests (5d)
- jordan/support: customer-impact summary and ticket list (EOD today)
- mary: legal review (as needed, 48h notice)

jordan: Support note: I'll ping the three affected customers with a short acknowledgment and ETA update now, will follow with postmortem when available.

sam: For peer review, please include @dave and @elaine for infra checks, @katie and @jordan for impact. @mary for legal review before anything customer-facing.

katie: Scheduling: propose postmortem sync on Friday 10:00 PT (link: https://meet.company/pm-rca). If that works, I'll book calendar and invite reviewers.

miguel: Friday 10:00 PT works for me.

dave: Works for me.

support: Will be there to present customer transcripts.

sam: Quick note for RCA draft checklist: timeline with exact timestamps, root cause hypothesis, contributing factors (config change + lack of guardrails), mitigation timeline, monitoring gaps, impact summary, action items with owners and delivery dates.

katie: Adding that to the doc template. Also please add any relevant small reproductions or scripts used during triage.

sam: One blocker: we need metric retention for the detailed 1s histograms at 30 days for deeper analysis. filing ticket now to request extended retention for this incident's metrics snapshot.

mary: A heads-up: if any customer data is included in attachments, run it through redaction checklist.

katie: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene on the Friday sync. If anything changes before then (new customer impact, regression, or further errors), tag this thread and escalate. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Reminder set: postmortem sync Friday 10:00 PT. Document draft due in 72h.
